# elk_82: submission package (generated by `leakproof package`; nothing has been posted)

> **Verified, needs human review.** Neither project tests nor a fuzz harness ran, so the gate saw only the reproducer (and any generated or adversary inputs). Read the diff before sending.

Issue: https://github.com/cesanta/elk/issues/82
Defect: heap-buffer-overflow in `next` (`elk.c:535`). Gate verdict: **verified**; evidence: verified, needs human review.

**Partial fix.** Not fixed here: numbers are still parsed with strtod past the slice length (the issue's first case).

## The patch

`0001-elk-fix-heap-buffer-overflow-in-next.patch` (this directory), `git format-patch` form: apply with `git am 0001-elk-fix-heap-buffer-overflow-in-next.patch`. The
author is `<your git identity>` unless `--author` was given; fix it with
`git commit --amend --reset-author`.

```diff
diff --git a/elk.c b/elk.c
--- a/elk.c
+++ b/elk.c
@@ -532,7 +532,7 @@
         }
         js->tlen += increment;
       }
-      if (buf[0] == buf[js->tlen]) js->tok = TOK_STRING, js->tlen++;
+      if (js->toff + js->tlen < js->clen && buf[0] == buf[js->tlen]) js->tok = TOK_STRING, js->tlen++;
       break;
     case '0': case '1': case '2': case '3': case '4': case '5': case '6': case '7': case '8': case '9': {
       char *end;
```

## Planner's analysis (written before the fix; check it against the diff)

Nemotron 3 Ultra wrote this root-cause analysis before any patch existed. It can describe a
different mechanism than the one the final diff fixes, so it is here for the reviewer and never
in the commit message.

> In the `next()` function at line 535, when parsing string literals (single or double quoted), the while loop exits either when finding the closing quote or when reaching the end of input. After the loop, the code unconditionally accesses `buf[js->tlen]` to check for the closing quote, but if the string is unterminated, `js->tlen` equals the remaining buffer length (`js->clen - js->toff`), making `buf[js->tlen]` an out-of-bounds read (one byte past the allocated heap buffer).

## Commit message (in the patch)

```
elk: fix heap-buffer-overflow in next()

AddressSanitizer reports a heap-buffer-overflow in next() (elk.c:535).

The change, in elk.c:

    -      if (buf[0] == buf[js->tlen]) js->tok = TOK_STRING, js->tlen++;
    +      if (js->toff + js->tlen < js->clen && buf[0] == buf[js->tlen]) js->tok = TOK_STRING, js->tlen++;

Part of #82.
```
